# langfuse_project (Data Source)

Look up the project that a project-scoped API key belongs to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "project_public_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "project_secret_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

data "langfuse_project" "current" {
  project_public_key = var.project_public_key
  project_secret_key = var.project_secret_key
}

output "project_id" {
  value = data.langfuse_project.current.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_public_key` (String, Sensitive) The project public key used to authenticate API calls.
- `project_secret_key` (String, Sensitive) The project secret key used to authenticate API calls.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The project ID.
- `metadata` (String) The project metadata as a JSON object.
- `name` (String) The project name.
- `organization_id` (String) The ID of the organization that owns the project.
- `organization_name` (String) The name of the organization that owns the project.
